title: system-invariants-fixture-performance
outOfScope: Changing system-invariant production logic, weakening any invariant assertion, or changing provider configuration.
Deleting historical archives, worktrees, or user-managed local data.

sources.reason: The repeated full repository fixture copies are the measured slowest local tests.
Full quality evidence measured five system-invariant fixture tests at 170-232 seconds each.
Local worktree contents expanded each copied fixture to roughly 852MB and caused multi-gigabyte pytest temporary output.

riskAssessment.reason: Fixture construction changes can accidentally mutate the source repository or reduce invariant coverage; linked read-only views and per-file copies must preserve isolation.

reasons: Shared system-invariant fixtures and full quality execution are governance reliability boundaries.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized governed writes and the measured fixture-only optimization has bounded, locally verifiable behavior.

preReviewWarnings: Review that source paths remain read-only and every intentionally mutated fixture file is copied before mutation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: System-invariant fixtures exclude `.worktrees` and other local execution artifacts, so they do not copy user-managed worktrees into pytest temporary directories.
Every system-invariant test that mutates a fixture retains an isolated writable copy of only its mutation target while the remaining repository view is read-only linked data.
The full system-invariant test module passes with identical positive and negative invariant assertions, and focused evidence demonstrates substantially reduced fixture setup cost.
guidelines: Preserve every existing system-invariant assertion and negative-path coverage; optimize only fixture construction.
Never mutate the source repository through a linked fixture path; copy each file before the test writes it.
Do not include local worktrees, credentials, virtual environments, caches, or generated execution output in a fixture repository view.

intent.problem: System-invariant tests repeatedly copy the complete repository, including a large user-managed `.worktrees` directory. The resulting fixtures are about 852MB each, consume multi-gigabyte pytest temporary storage, and dominate full-quality runtime without adding test coverage.
constraints: Preserve test isolation and all existing invariant assertions.
Do not modify production invariant logic, provider configuration, or user worktrees.
Use only deterministic local filesystem behavior; source files must remain unchanged by fixture mutations.
intent.rationale: A linked read-only repository view with explicit writable copies removes irrelevant local data from fixture setup while retaining the same system-invariant behavior and failure coverage.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A test fixture view has no copied `.worktrees` directory and source worktrees remain untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused system-invariant fixture tests and inspect their temporary repository views.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing baseline, invalid archive summary, and documentation mutation cases still fail or pass exactly as before without modifying the source repository.

rawUserRequest: Continue all governed Work Items and improve performance without reducing quality. The measured system-invariant fixture copies must be made efficient while preserving verification.

declaredIntent.summary: Remove irrelevant local worktree copying from system-invariant test fixtures without weakening verification.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized required Contract and governed Work Item writes for this and future Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
